032    protected static Point2D POINT2ToPoint2D(POINT2 pt2) {
033        if (pt2 == null) {
034            return null;
035        }
036
037        double x = pt2.x;
038        double y = pt2.y;
039        Point2D pt = new Point2D.Double(x, y);
040        return pt;
041    }
042    /**
043     * returns true if the line segments are all outside the bounds
044     * @param tg the tactical graphic
045     * @param clipBounds the pixels based clip bounds
046     * @return 
047     */
048    public static boolean linesOutsideClipBounds(TGLight tg,
049            Rectangle2D clipBounds)
050    {
051        try
052        {
053            boolean isAutoshape=isAutoshape(tg);
054            if(isAutoshape)
055                return false;
056
057            double xmin=clipBounds.getMinX();
058            double xmax=clipBounds.getMaxX();
059            double ymin=clipBounds.getMinY();
060            double ymax=clipBounds.getMaxY();
061            int j=0;
062            POINT2 pt0=null,pt1=null;
063            Line2D boundsEdge=null,ptsLine=null;
064            int n=tg.Pixels.size();
065            //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size()-1;j++)
066            for(j=0;j<n-1;j++)
067            {
068                pt0=tg.Pixels.get(j);
069                pt1=tg.Pixels.get(j+1);
070                
071                //if either point is inside the bounds return false
072                if(clipBounds.contains(pt0.x, pt0.y))
073                    return false;
074                if(clipBounds.contains(pt1.x, pt1.y))
075                    return false;
076                
077                ptsLine=new Line2D.Double(pt0.x,pt0.y,pt1.x,pt1.y);
078                
079                //if the pt0-pt1 line intersects any clip bounds edge then return false
080                boundsEdge=new Line2D.Double(xmin,ymin,xmax,ymin);
081                if(ptsLine.intersectsLine(boundsEdge))
082                    return false;                
083                
084                boundsEdge=new Line2D.Double(xmax,ymin,xmax,ymax);
085                if(ptsLine.intersectsLine(boundsEdge))
086                    return false;                
087                
088                boundsEdge=new Line2D.Double(xmax,ymax,xmin,ymax);
089                if(ptsLine.intersectsLine(boundsEdge))
090                    return false;                
091                
092                boundsEdge=new Line2D.Double(xmin,ymax,xmin,ymin);
093                if(ptsLine.intersectsLine(boundsEdge))
094                    return false;                
095            }
096        }
097        catch (Exception exc) 
098        {
099            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"linesOutsideClipBounds",
100                    new RendererException("Failed inside linesOutsideClipBounds", exc));
101        }    
102        return true;
103    }

533    /**
534     * Closes the polygon for areas
535     * @param Pixels the client points
536     */
537    public static void ClosePolygon(ArrayList<POINT2> Pixels) {
538        try {
539            POINT2 pt0 = Pixels.get(0);
540            POINT2 pt1 = Pixels.get(Pixels.size() - 1);
541            if (pt0.x != pt1.x || pt0.y != pt1.y) {
542                Pixels.add(new POINT2(pt0.x, pt0.y));
543            }
544        } catch (Exception exc) {
545               ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"ClosePolygon",
546                    new RendererException("Failed inside ClosePolygon", exc));
547        }
548    }
549    /**
550     * for change 1 symbol the W/w1 modifiers run too close to the symbol outline
551     * so it shifts the line along the line away from the edge
552     * @param pt0
553     * @param pt1
554     */
555    protected static void shiftModifiersLeft(POINT2 p1, POINT2 p2, double shift)
556    {
557        try
558        {
559            POINT2 pt1=new POINT2(p1);
560            POINT2 pt2=new POINT2(p2);
561            double dist=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt1, pt2);
562            if(pt1.x<pt2.x || (pt1.x==pt2.x && pt1.y<pt2.y))
563            {
564                pt1=lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pt2, pt1, dist+shift);
565                pt2=lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pt1, pt2, dist-shift);
566            }
567            else
568            {
569                pt1=lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pt2, pt1, dist-shift);
570                pt2=lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pt1, pt2, dist+shift);
571            }
572            p1.x=pt1.x;
573            p1.y=pt1.y;
574            p2.x=pt2.x;
575            p2.y=pt2.y;
576        }
577        catch (Exception exc) {
578               ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"shiftModifiersLeft",
579                    new RendererException("Failed inside shiftModifiersLeft", exc));
580        }
581    }
582    /**
583     * Overrides shape properties for symbols based on Mil-Std-2525
584     * @param tg
585     * @param shape
586     */
587    protected static void ResolveModifierShape(TGLight tg, Shape2 shape) {
588        try {
589            //shape style was set by CELineArray and takes precedence
590            //whenever it is set
591            int shapeStyle = shape.get_Style();
592            int lineStyle = tg.get_LineStyle();
593            int lineType = tg.get_LineType();
594            boolean hasFill=LinesWithFill(lineType);
595            int bolMETOC=clsMETOC.IsWeather(tg.get_SymbolId());
596            if(bolMETOC>0)
597                return;
598            int fillStyle=0;
599            //for some of these the style must be dashed
600            switch (tg.get_LineType()) {
601                case TacticalLines.FEBA:
602                    shape.setFillColor(null);
603                    shape.set_Style(tg.get_LineStyle());
604                    shape.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());                    
605                    break;
606                case TacticalLines.NFA:
607                case TacticalLines.NFA_CIRCULAR:
608                case TacticalLines.NFA_RECTANGULAR:
609                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXBLUE:
610                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE:
611                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXBLUE_RECTANGULAR:
612                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE_RECTANGULAR:
613                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXBLUE_CIRCULAR:
614                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE_CIRCULAR:
615                case TacticalLines.BIO:
616                case TacticalLines.CHEM:
617                case TacticalLines.RAD:
618                case TacticalLines.WFZ:
619                //case TacticalLines.OBSAREA:
620                    fillStyle=3;
621                    if(tg.get_UseHatchFill())
622                        fillStyle=0;
623                    if (shape.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE) {
624                        shape.set_Style(tg.get_LineStyle());
625                        shape.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
626                        shape.set_Fillstyle(fillStyle /*GraphicProperties.FILL_TYPE_RIGHT_SLANTS*/);//was 3
627                        shape.setFillColor(tg.get_FillColor());
628                    }
629                    break;
630                case TacticalLines.OBSAREA:
631                    if (shape.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE) {
632                        shape.set_Style(tg.get_LineStyle());
633                        shape.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
634                        shape.set_Fillstyle(0 /*GraphicProperties.FILL_TYPE_RIGHT_SLANTS*/);
635                        shape.setFillColor(tg.get_FillColor());
636                    }
637                    break;
638                case TacticalLines.LAA:
639                    fillStyle=2;
640                    if(tg.get_UseHatchFill())
641                        fillStyle=0;
642                    if (shape.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE) {
643                        shape.set_Style(tg.get_LineStyle());
644                        shape.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
645                        shape.set_Fillstyle(fillStyle /*GraphicProperties.FILL_TYPE_LEFT_SLANTS*/);//was 2
646                        shape.setFillColor(tg.get_FillColor());
647                    }
648                    break;
649                case TacticalLines.OVERHEAD_WIRE_LS:
650                    if (shape.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL) {
651                        shape.set_Fillstyle(1 /*GraphicProperties.FILL_TYPE_SOLID*/);
652                        shape.setFillColor(tg.get_LineColor());
653                    }
654                    if (shape.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE) {
655                        shape.set_Style(1);
656                        shape.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
657                    }
658                    break;
659                case TacticalLines.DIRATKAIR:
660                case TacticalLines.ATDITCHC:
661                case TacticalLines.ATDITCHM:
662                case TacticalLines.SARA:
663                case TacticalLines.FOLSP:
664                case TacticalLines.FERRY:
665                case TacticalLines.MNFLDFIX:
666                case TacticalLines.TURN:
667                case TacticalLines.MNFLDDIS:
668                case TacticalLines.EASY:
669                case TacticalLines.BYDIF:
670                case TacticalLines.BYIMP:
671                    if (shape.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL) {
672                        shape.set_Fillstyle(1 /*GraphicProperties.FILL_TYPE_SOLID*/);
673                        shape.setFillColor(tg.get_LineColor());
674                    }
675                    if (shape.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE) {
676                        shape.set_Style(tg.get_LineStyle());
677                        shape.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
678                    }
679                    break;
680                case TacticalLines.DECEIVE: //any shape for these symbols is dashed
681                case TacticalLines.CLUSTER:
682                case TacticalLines.CATK:
683                case TacticalLines.CATKBYFIRE:
684                case TacticalLines.PLD:
685                case TacticalLines.PLANNED:
686                case TacticalLines.CFL:
687                case TacticalLines.FORDSITE:
688                    if (shape.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE) {
689                        shape.set_Style(1 /*GraphicProperties.LINE_TYPE_DASHED*/);
690                        shape.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
691                    }
692                    break;
693                case TacticalLines.PNO: //always dashed
694                    if (shape.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE) {
695                        shape.set_Style(1 /*GraphicProperties.LINE_TYPE_DASHED*/);
696                        shape.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
697                        shape.setFillColor(tg.get_FillColor());
698                        shape.set_Fillstyle(tg.get_FillStyle());
699                    }
700                    break;
701                case TacticalLines.DMA: //these symbols are partially dashed
702                case TacticalLines.DMAF:
703                    if (shape.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE) {
704                        shape.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
705                        if (shapeStyle != lineStyle) {
706                            if (shapeStyle != 1 /*GraphicProperties.LINE_TYPE_DASHED*/) {
707                                shape.set_Style(lineStyle);
708                            }
709                        }
710                    }
711                    break;
712                case TacticalLines.DUMMY:
713                case TacticalLines.DIRATKFNT:
714                case TacticalLines.FOLLA:
715                case TacticalLines.ESR1:
716                case TacticalLines.FORDIF:
717                    if (shape.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE) {
718                        shape.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
719                        if (shapeStyle != lineStyle) {
720                            if (shapeStyle != 1 /*GraphicProperties.LINE_TYPE_DASHED*/) {
721                                shape.set_Style(lineStyle);
722                            }
723                        }
724                    }
725                    break;
726                case TacticalLines.AAFNT:
727                    if (shape.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE) {
728                        shape.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
729                        if (shapeStyle != lineStyle) {
730                            if (shapeStyle != 2 /*GraphicProperties.LINE_TYPE_DOTTED*/) {
731                                shape.set_Style(lineStyle);
732                            }
733                        }
734                    }
735                    break;
736                default:
737                    if (shape.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL) {
738                        shape.set_Fillstyle(tg.get_FillStyle());
739                        shape.setFillColor(tg.get_FillColor());
740                    }
741                    if (shape.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE) {
742                        if (lineType != TacticalLines.LC)//shape linecolor set by Channels class for LC
743                        {
744                            shape.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
745                        }
746                        shape.set_Style(lineStyle);
747                        if (hasFill || clsUtility.isClosedPolygon(lineType) || clsUtility.IsChange1Area(lineType, null))
748                        {
749                            switch(lineType)
750                            {
751                                case TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN:
752                                case TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_SECTOR:
753                                case TacticalLines.BBS_AREA:
754                                case TacticalLines.BBS_RECTANGLE:
755                                    shape.setFillColor(null);
756                                    break;
757                                default:
758                                    shape.set_Fillstyle(tg.get_FillStyle());
759                                    shape.setFillColor(tg.get_FillColor());
760                                    break;
761                            }
762                        }
763                        switch(lineType)
764                        {
765                            case TacticalLines.BS_ELLIPSE:
766                            //case TacticalLines.PBS_ELLIPSE:
767                            //case TacticalLines.PBS_CIRCLE:
768                            case TacticalLines.BS_RECTANGLE:
769                            //case TacticalLines.BBS_RECTANGLE:
770                                shape.set_Fillstyle(tg.get_FillStyle());
771                                shape.setFillColor(tg.get_FillColor());
772                                break;
773                            case TacticalLines.BBS_RECTANGLE:
774                            case TacticalLines.PBS_RECTANGLE:
775                            case TacticalLines.PBS_SQUARE:
776                            case TacticalLines.PBS_ELLIPSE:
777                            case TacticalLines.PBS_CIRCLE:
778                                shape.setFillColor(null);
779                                break;
780                            default:
781                                break;
782                        }
783                    }
784                    break;
785            }
786
787        } catch (Exception exc) {
788               ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"ResolveModifierShape",
789                    new RendererException("Failed inside ResolveModifierShape", exc));
790        }
791    }

879    /**
880     * @deprecated
881     * if the line color and fill color are the same or very close then we want to
882     * tweak the fill color a bit to make the line appear distinct from the fill.
883     * @param tg
884     */
885    public static void tweakFillColor(TGLight tg)
886    {
887        try
888        {
889            if(isSameColor(tg.get_LineColor(),tg.get_FillColor())==false)
890                return;
891
892            Color fillColor=tg.get_FillColor();
893            int r=fillColor.getRed(),g=fillColor.getGreen(),b=fillColor.getBlue();
894            int alpha=fillColor.getAlpha();
895
896            r*=0.9;
897            g*=0.9;
898            b*=0.9;
899            alpha*=0.8;
900
901            fillColor=new Color(r,g,b,alpha);
902            tg.set_FillColor(fillColor);
903        }
904        catch(Exception exc)
905        {
906               ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"tweakFillColor",
907                    new RendererException("Failed inside tweakFillColor", exc));
908        }
909    }
910    /**
911     * @deprecated
912     * Test to see if two colors are similar
913     * @param c1
914     * @param c2
915     * @return true is same (or similar) color
916     */
917    public static Boolean isSameColor(Color c1, Color c2)
918    {
919        try
920        {
921            if(c1==null || c2==null)
922                return true;
923
924            int r1=c1.getRed(),r2=c2.getRed(),g1=c1.getGreen(),g2=c2.getGreen(),
925                    b1=c1.getBlue(),b2=c2.getBlue();
926
927            if(Math.abs(r1-r2)<5)
928                if(Math.abs(g1-g2)<5)
929                    if(Math.abs(b1-b2)<5)
930                        return true;
931        }
932        catch(Exception exc)
933        {
934               ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"isSameColor",
935                    new RendererException("Failed inside isSameColor", exc));
936        }
937        return false;
938    }
939    /**
940     * Customer requested routine for setting the stroke dash pattern
941     * @param width
942     * @param style
943     * @param cap
944     * @param round
945     * @return
946     */
947    public static BasicStroke getLineStroke(float width, int style, int cap, int round)
948    {
949        // NOTE: We restrict ourselves to using a base dash array of
950        // approximately length 8 (scaled by width). CPOF's 3D map usesOpenGL
951        // stippling and this works with bit patterns of exactly 16bits.
952        // We could increase our base dash array to length 16 if itwere necessary
953        // in order to support a new stipple type.
954
955        // Some segments are of length 0.1 because the Java2D rendereradds line caps of
956        // width/2 size to both ends of the segment when "round" is oneof BasicStroke.CAP_ROUND
957        // or BasicStroke.CAP_SQUARE. This value is small enough not to affect the
958        // stipple bit pattern calculation for the 3d map and stilllook good on the
959        // 2d map.
960
961        // NOTE: The dash arrays below do not supportBasisStroke.CAP_BUTT line capping,
962        // although it would be relatively simple to change them suchthat they would.
963        BasicStroke stroke=null;
964        try
965        {
966            switch (style)
967            {
968                case 0://GraphicProperties.LINE_TYPE_SOLID:
969                    stroke = new BasicStroke(width, cap, round);
970                    break;
971                case 1://GraphicProperties.LINE_TYPE_DASHED:
972                    float[] dash = {2*width, 2*width, 2*width, 2*width};
973                    stroke = new BasicStroke(width, cap, round, 4f, dash, 0f);
974                    break;
975                case 2://GraphicProperties.LINE_TYPE_DOTTED:
976                    float[] dot = {0.1f*width, 2f*width, 0.1f*width,2f*width, 0.1f*width, 2f*width, 0.1f*width, 2f*width};
977                    stroke = new BasicStroke(width, cap, round, 4f, dot, 0f);
978                    break;
979                case 3://GraphicProperties.LINE_TYPE_DASHDOT:
980                    float[] dashdot = {4f*width, 2f*width, 0.1f*width,2f*width};
981                    stroke = new BasicStroke(width, cap, round, 4f, dashdot,0f );
982                    break;
983                case 4://GraphicProperties.LINE_TYPE_DASHDOTDOT:
984                    float[] dashdotdot = {2f*width, 2f*width, 0.1f*width,2f*width, 0.1f*width, 2f*width};
985                    stroke = new BasicStroke(width, cap, round, 4f,dashdotdot, 0f );
986                    break;
987                default:
988                    stroke = new BasicStroke(width, cap, round);
989                    break;
990            }
991        }
992        catch(Exception exc)
993        {
994               ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"getLineStroke",
995                    new RendererException("Failed inside getLineStroke", exc));
996        }
997        return stroke;
998    }

1020
1021        // NOTE: The dash arrays below do not supportBasisStroke.CAP_BUTT line capping,

1061    /**
1062     * Sets shape properties based on other properties which were set by JavaLineArray
1063     * @param tg tactical graphic
1064     * @param shapes the ShapeInfo array
1065     * @param bi BufferedImage to use for setting shape TexturePaint
1066     */
1067    public static void SetShapeProperties(TGLight tg, ArrayList<Shape2> shapes,
1068            BufferedImage bi) {
1069        try
1070        {
1071            if (shapes == null)
1072            {
1073                return;
1074            }
1075            
1076            int j = 0;
1077            Shape2 shape = null;
1078            BasicStroke stroke = null;
1079            float[] dash = null;
1080            int lineThickness = tg.get_LineThickness();
1081            int shapeType = -1;
1082            int lineType = tg.get_LineType();
1083            boolean hasFill=LinesWithFill(lineType);
1084            boolean isChange1Area = clsUtility.IsChange1Area(lineType, null);
1085            boolean isClosedPolygon = clsUtility.isClosedPolygon(lineType);
1086            //int n=shapes.size();
1087            //remove air corridors fill shapes if fill is null
1088            if(tg.get_FillColor()==null)
1089            {
1090                switch(tg.get_LineType())
1091                {
1092                    case TacticalLines.AC:
1093                    case TacticalLines.SAAFR:
1094                    case TacticalLines.MRR:
1095                    case TacticalLines.MRR_USAS:
1096                    case TacticalLines.UAV:
1097                    case TacticalLines.UAV_USAS:
1098                    case TacticalLines.LLTR:
1099                        shape=shapes.get(shapes.size()-1);
1100                        shapes.clear();
1101                        shapes.add(shape);
1102                        break;
1103                    case TacticalLines.CATK:
1104                    case TacticalLines.AXAD:
1105                    case TacticalLines.AIRAOA:
1106                    case TacticalLines.AAAAA:
1107                    case TacticalLines.SPT:
1108                    case TacticalLines.AAFNT:           //40
1109                    case TacticalLines.MAIN:
1110                    case TacticalLines.CATKBYFIRE:      //80
1111                        ArrayList<Shape2> tempShapes=new ArrayList();
1112                        for(j=0;j<shapes.size();j++)
1113                        {
1114                            shape=shapes.get(j);
1115                            if(shape.getShapeType() != Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL)
1116                                tempShapes.add(shape);
1117                        }
1118                        shapes=tempShapes;
1119                        break;
1120                    default:
1121                        break;
1122                }
1123            }
1124            for (j = 0; j < shapes.size(); j++) 
1125            {
1126                shape = shapes.get(j);
1127                if (shape == null || shape.getShape() == null) {
1128                    continue;
1129                }
1130
1131                if (shape.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL) 
1132                {
1133                    switch(tg.get_LineType())
1134                    {
1135                        case TacticalLines.DEPTH_AREA:
1136                            break;
1137                        default:
1138                            shape.setFillColor(tg.get_FillColor());
1139                            break;
1140                    }
1141                }
1142
1143                //if(lineType != TacticalLines.LEADING_LINE)
1144                ResolveModifierShape(tg, shape);
1145                if(lineType==TacticalLines.AIRFIELD)
1146                    if(j==1)
1147                        shape.setFillColor(null);
1148                //diagnostic
1149                if(lineType==TacticalLines.BBS_POINT)
1150                    if(j==0)
1151                        shape.setLineColor(null);
1152                //end section
1153                
1154                shapeType = shape.getShapeType();
1155
1156                if (lineType == TacticalLines.LC) {
1157                    SetLCColor(tg, shape);
1158                }
1159
1160                Rectangle2D.Double rect = null;
1161                Graphics2D grid = null;
1162                TexturePaint tp = tg.get_TexturePaint();
1163
1164                if (hasFill || isClosedPolygon || isChange1Area || shapeType == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL)
1165                {                    
1166                    switch (shape.get_FillStyle()) {

1297    /**
1298     * Returns a boolean indicating whether the line type is a change 1 area
1299     * @param lineType the line type
1300     * @param minPoints Out - object to hold the minimum number of client points required
1301     * @return true if change 1 area
1302     */
1303    public static boolean IsChange1Area(int lineType,
1304            ref<int[]> minPoints) {
1305        try {
1306            if (minPoints != null) {
1307                minPoints.value = new int[1];
1308            }
1309            switch (lineType) {
1310                case TacticalLines.LAUNCH_AREA:
1311                    if (minPoints != null) {
1312                        minPoints.value[0] = 1;
1313                    }
1314                    return true;
1315                case TacticalLines.FEBA:
1316                    if (minPoints != null) {
1317                        minPoints.value[0] = 1;
1318                    }
1319                    return false;
1320                case TacticalLines.RECTANGULAR:
1321                case TacticalLines.PBS_RECTANGLE:
1322                case TacticalLines.PBS_SQUARE:
1323                case TacticalLines.CIRCULAR:
1324                case TacticalLines.BBS_POINT:
1325                case TacticalLines.FSA_CIRCULAR:
1326                case TacticalLines.FFA_CIRCULAR:
1327                case TacticalLines.NFA_CIRCULAR:
1328                case TacticalLines.RFA_CIRCULAR:
1329                case TacticalLines.ACA_CIRCULAR:
1330                case TacticalLines.PAA_CIRCULAR:
1331                case TacticalLines.ATI_CIRCULAR:
1332                case TacticalLines.CFFZ_CIRCULAR:
1333                case TacticalLines.SENSOR_CIRCULAR:
1334                case TacticalLines.CENSOR_CIRCULAR:
1335                case TacticalLines.DA_CIRCULAR:
1336                case TacticalLines.CFZ_CIRCULAR:
1337                case TacticalLines.ZOR_CIRCULAR:
1338                case TacticalLines.TBA_CIRCULAR:
1339                case TacticalLines.TVAR_CIRCULAR:
1340                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXBLUE_CIRCULAR:
1341                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE_CIRCULAR:
1342                case TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN:
1343                case TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_FILL:
1344                case TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_SECTOR:
1345                    if (minPoints != null) {
1346                        minPoints.value[0] = 1;
1347                    }
1348                    return true;
1349                case TacticalLines.PAA_RECTANGULAR_REVC:
1350                case TacticalLines.FSA_RECTANGULAR:
1351                case TacticalLines.FFA_RECTANGULAR:
1352                case TacticalLines.RFA_RECTANGULAR:
1353                case TacticalLines.NFA_RECTANGULAR:
1354                case TacticalLines.ACA_RECTANGULAR:
1355                case TacticalLines.ATI_RECTANGULAR:
1356                case TacticalLines.CFFZ_RECTANGULAR:
1357                case TacticalLines.SENSOR_RECTANGULAR:
1358                case TacticalLines.CENSOR_RECTANGULAR:
1359                case TacticalLines.DA_RECTANGULAR:
1360                case TacticalLines.CFZ_RECTANGULAR:
1361                case TacticalLines.ZOR_RECTANGULAR:
1362                case TacticalLines.TBA_RECTANGULAR:
1363                case TacticalLines.TVAR_RECTANGULAR:
1364                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXBLUE_RECTANGULAR:
1365                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE_RECTANGULAR:
1366                    if (minPoints != null) {
1367                        minPoints.value[0] = 1;
1368                    }
1369                    return true;
1370                default:
1371                    return false;
1372            }
1373        } catch (Exception exc) {
1374            //clsUtility.WriteFile("Error in clsUtility.IsChange1Area");
1375               ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"IsChange1Area",
1376                    new RendererException("Failed inside IsChange1Area", exc));
1377        }
1378        return false;
1379    }

1396    /**
1397     * Calculates point where two lines intersect.
1398     * First line defined by pt1, m1.
1399     * Second line defined by pt2, m2.
1400     * result will be written to ptIntersect.
1401     * @param pt1 first line point
1402     * @param m1 slope of first line
1403     * @param pt2 second line point
1404     * @param m2 slope of second line
1405     * @param ptIntersect OUT - intersection point
1406     */
1407    protected static void CalcIntersectPt(POINT2 pt1,
1408            double m1,
1409            POINT2 pt2,
1410            double m2,
1411            POINT2 ptIntersect) {
1412        try {
1413            if (m1 == m2) {
1414                return;
1415            }
1416
1417            double x1 = pt1.x;
1418            double y1 = pt1.y;
1419            double x2 = pt2.x;
1420            double y2 = pt2.y;
1421            //formula for the intersection of two lines
1422            double dx2 = (double) ((y1 - y2 + m1 * x2 - m1 * x1) / (m2 - m1));
1423            double x3 = x2 + dx2;
1424            double y3 = (double) (y2 + m2 * dx2);
1425
1426            ptIntersect.x = x3;
1427            ptIntersect.y = y3;
1428        } catch (Exception exc) {
1429            //clsUtility.WriteFile("Error in clsUtility.CalcIntersectPt");
1430            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "CalcIntersectPt",
1431                    new RendererException("Failed inside CalcIntersectPt", exc));
1432        }
1433    }

1435    /**
1436     * Calculates the channel width in pixels for channel types
1437     * @param pixels the client points as 2-tuples x,y in pixels
1438     * @param distanceToChannelPOINT2 OUT - the calculated distance in pixels from the tip of the
1439     * arrowhead to the back of the arrowhead.
1440     * @return the channel width in pixels
1441     */
1442    protected static int ChannelWidth(double[] pixels,
1443            ref<double[]> distanceToChannelPOINT2) {
1444        int width = 0;
1445        try {
1446            int numPOINT2s = pixels.length / 2;
1447            if (numPOINT2s < 3) {
1448                return 0;
1449            }
1450
1451            POINT2 channelWidthPOINT2 = new POINT2(0, 0);
1452            POINT2 lastSegmentPt1 = new POINT2(0, 0);
1453            POINT2 lastSegmentPt2 = new POINT2(0, 0);
1454
1455            lastSegmentPt1.x = (double) pixels[2 * numPOINT2s - 6];
1456            lastSegmentPt1.y = (double) pixels[2 * numPOINT2s - 5];
1457            lastSegmentPt2.x = (double) pixels[2 * numPOINT2s - 4];
1458            lastSegmentPt2.y = (double) pixels[2 * numPOINT2s - 3];
1459            channelWidthPOINT2.x = (double) pixels[2 * numPOINT2s - 2];
1460            channelWidthPOINT2.y = (double) pixels[2 * numPOINT2s - 1];
1461
1462            ref<double[]> m = new ref();
1463            double m1 = 0;
1464            //m1.value=new double[1];
1465            double distance = 0;
1466            POINT2 ptIntersect = new POINT2(0, 0);
1467            //boolean bolVertical = TrueSlope(lastSegmentPt1, lastSegmentPt2, ref m);
1468            boolean bolVertical = lineutility.CalcTrueSlopeDouble2(lastSegmentPt1, lastSegmentPt2, m);
1469            if (bolVertical == true && m.value[0] != 0) {
1470                m1 = -1 / m.value[0];
1471                CalcIntersectPt(channelWidthPOINT2, m1, lastSegmentPt2, m.value[0], ptIntersect);
1472                distance = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(channelWidthPOINT2, ptIntersect);
1473            }
1474            if (bolVertical == true && m.value[0] == 0) //horizontal segment
1475            {
1476                distance = Math.abs(channelWidthPOINT2.y - lastSegmentPt1.y);
1477            }
1478            if (bolVertical == false) //vertical segment
1479            {
1480                distance = Math.abs(channelWidthPOINT2.x - lastSegmentPt1.x);
1481                distanceToChannelPOINT2.value = new double[1];
1482                distanceToChannelPOINT2.value[0] = distance;
1483                return (int) distance * 4;
1484            }
1485
1486            width = (int) distance * 8;
1487            if (width < 2) {
1488                width = 2;
1489            }
1490
1491            double hypotenuse = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(lastSegmentPt2, channelWidthPOINT2);
1492            distanceToChannelPOINT2.value = new double[1];
1493            distanceToChannelPOINT2.value[0] = Math.sqrt(hypotenuse * hypotenuse - distance * distance);
1494
1495        } catch (Exception exc) {
1496            //clsUtility.WriteFile("Error in clsUtility.ChannelWidth");
1497            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "ChannelWidth",
1498                    new RendererException("Failed inside ChannelWidth", exc));
1499        }
1500        return width;
1501    }

1503    private static boolean InYOrder(POINT2 pt0,
1504            POINT2 pt1,
1505            POINT2 pt2) {
1506        try {
1507            if (pt0.y <= pt1.y && pt1.y <= pt2.y) {
1508                return true;
1509            }
1510
1511            if (pt2.y <= pt1.y && pt1.y <= pt0.y) {
1512                return true;
1513            }
1514
1515        } catch (Exception exc) {
1516            //clsUtility.WriteFile("Error in clsUtility.InYOrder");
1517            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "InYOrder",
1518                    new RendererException("Failed inside InYOrder", exc));
1519        }
1520        return false;
1521    }
1522    /// <summary>
1523    /// tests if POINT2s have successively increasing or decreasing x values.
1524    /// </summary>
1525    /// <param name="pt0"></param>
1526    /// <param name="pt1"></param>
1527    /// <param name="pt2"></param>
1528    /// <returns>true if POINT2s are in X order</returns>
1529
1530    private static boolean InXOrder(POINT2 pt0,
1531            POINT2 pt1,
1532            POINT2 pt2) {
1533        try {
1534            if (pt0.x <= pt1.x && pt1.x <= pt2.x) {
1535                return true;
1536            }
1537
1538            if (pt2.x <= pt1.x && pt1.x <= pt0.x) {
1539                return true;
1540            }
1541
1542        } catch (Exception exc) {
1543            //clsUtility.WriteFile("Error in clsUtility.InXOrder");
1544            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "InXOrder",
1545                    new RendererException("Failed inside InXOrder", exc));
1546        }
1547        return false;
1548    }

1550    /**
1551     * For each sector calculates left azimuth, right azimuth, min radius, max radius
1552     * and stuff H2 with the string delimited result. The function is public, called by JavaRendererServer
1553     * @param tg tactical graphic
1554     */
1555    public static void GetSectorRadiiFromPoints(TGLight tg) {
1556        try {
1557            if(tg.get_LineType()==TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_FILL)
1558                return;
1559            POINT2 ptCenter = tg.LatLongs.get(0);
1560            POINT2 ptLeftMin = new POINT2(), ptRightMax = new POINT2();
1561            int k = 0;
1562            String strLeft = "", strRight = "", strMin = "", strMax = "", temp = "";
1563            double nLeft = 0, nRight = 0, nMin = 0, nMax = 0;
1564            //if tg.PointCollection has more than one point
1565            //we use the points to calculate left,right,min,max
1566            //and then stuff tg.H2 with the comma delimited string
1567            double dist = 0;
1568            ref<double[]> a12 = new ref(), a21 = new ref();
1569            int numSectors = 0;
1570            if (tg.LatLongs.size() > 2) {
1571                numSectors = (tg.LatLongs.size() - 2) / 2;
1572                for (k = 0; k < numSectors; k++) {
1573                    //get the sector points
1574                    ptLeftMin = tg.LatLongs.get(2 * k + 2);
1575                    ptRightMax = tg.LatLongs.get(2 * k + 3);
1576
1577                    dist = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(ptCenter, ptLeftMin, a12, a21);
1578                    nLeft = a12.value[0];
1579                    strLeft = Double.toString(nLeft);
1580
1581                    nMin = dist;
1582                    strMin = Double.toString(nMin);
1583
1584                    dist = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(ptCenter, ptRightMax, a12, a21);
1585                    nRight = a12.value[0];
1586                    strRight = Double.toString(nRight);
1587
1588                    nMax = dist;
1589                    strMax = Double.toString(nMax);
1590
1591                    if (k == 0) {
1592                        temp = strLeft + "," + strRight + "," + strMin + "," + strMax;
1593                    } else {
1594                        temp += "," + strLeft + "," + strRight + "," + strMin + "," + strMax;
1595                    }
1596                }
1597                if (!temp.equals("")) {
1598                    tg.set_H2(temp);
1599                }
1600            }
1601        } catch (Exception exc) {
1602            //clsUtility.WriteFile("Error in clsUtility.GetSectorRadiiFromPoints");
1603            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetSectorRadiiFromPoints",
1604                    new RendererException("Failed inside GetSectorRadiiFromPoints", exc));
1605        }
1606    }

1608    /**
1609     * Note: Mil-Std-2525 Rev C does not use this function.
1610     * For Rev C the radii are calculated from tg.H2
1611     * Calculates the radii for circular and sector range fans.
1612     * @param tg
1613     * @param lineType
1614     * @return
1615     */
1616    public static double[] GetRadii(TGLight tg, 
1617            int lineType) {
1618        double[] radius = null;
1619        try {
1620            //if the client passed more than one point we use the
1621            //additional points to calculate the radii
1622            //ArrayList<Double> rads=new ArrayList();
1623            if (lineType == TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN &&
1624                    tg.LatLongs.size() > 2)
1625            {
1626
1627                POINT2 ptCenter = tg.LatLongs.get(0);
1628
1629                POINT2 pt = new POINT2();
1630                double dist = 0;
1631                ref<double[]> a12 = new ref(), a21 = new ref();
1632                int rad = 0;
1633                String temp = "";
1634                //we skip tg.PointCollection.get_Point(1) because
1635                //that's the orientation point
1636                int t=tg.LatLongs.size();
1637                //for (int j = 2; j < tg.LatLongs.size(); j++)
1638                for (int j = 2; j < t; j++)
1639                {
1640                    pt = new POINT2(tg.LatLongs.get(j));
1641                    dist = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(ptCenter, pt, a12, a21);
1642                    rad = (int) dist;
1643                    if (rad <= 0) {
1644                        continue;
1645                    }
1646                    if (j == 2) {
1647                        temp = Double.toString(rad);
1648                    } else {
1649                        temp += ",";
1650                        temp += Double.toString(rad);
1651                    }
1652                }
1653                tg.set_H2(temp);
1654                //clsTGProperties.set_H2Field(temp);
1655            }
1656            String[] strRadius = null;
1657            String radii = tg.get_H2();
1658
1659            if (lineType == TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_SECTOR)
1660            {
1661                GetSectorRadiiFromPoints(tg);
1662                radii = tg.get_H2();
1663            }
1664            strRadius = radii.split(",");
1665
1666
1667            int n = strRadius.length;
1668            if (n > 0) {
1669                radius = new double[n];
1670            } else {
1671                return null;
1672            }
1673
1674            if (lineType == TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN) {
1675                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
1676                    radius[k] = Double.parseDouble(strRadius[k]);
1677                }
1678            } //there are twice as many strings in H1 as radii for scetor range fans
1679            else if (lineType == TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_SECTOR) {
1680                int numSectors = n / 4;
1681                double[] radius2 = new double[numSectors * 2];
1682                int l = 0;
1683                for (int k = 0; k < numSectors; k++) {
1684                    radius2[l++] = Double.parseDouble(strRadius[4 * k + 2]);
1685                    radius2[l++] = Double.parseDouble(strRadius[4 * k + 3]);
1686                }
1687                radius = radius2;
1688            }
1689        } catch (Exception exc) {
1690            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetRadii",
1691                    new RendererException("Failed inside GetRadii", exc));
1692        }
1693        return radius;
1694    }

1696    /**
1697     * Reverses the pixels except for the last point. This is used for
1698     * the axis of advance type routes. The pixels are 2-tuples x,y
1699     *
1700     * @param pixels OUT - Array of client points
1701     */
1702    protected static void ReorderPixels(double[] pixels) {
1703        try {
1704            double[] tempPixels;
1705            //reverse the pixels
1706            int j;
1707            double x;
1708            double y;
1709            int counter;
1710            int numPoints;
1711            counter = 0;
1712            numPoints = pixels.length / 2;
1713            tempPixels = new double[pixels.length];
1714            for (j = 0; j < numPoints - 1; j++) {
1715                x = pixels[pixels.length - 2 * j - 4];
1716                y = pixels[pixels.length - 2 * j - 3];
1717                tempPixels[counter] = x;
1718                tempPixels[counter + 1] = y;
1719                counter += 2;
1720            }
1721            //put the last pixel point into the last temppixels point
1722            int intPixelSize = pixels.length;
1723            tempPixels[counter] = pixels[intPixelSize - 2];
1724            tempPixels[counter + 1] = pixels[intPixelSize - 1];
1725            //stuff the pixels
1726            int n=pixels.length;
1727            //for (j = 0; j < pixels.length; j++) 
1728            for (j = 0; j < n; j++) 
1729            {
1730                pixels[j] = tempPixels[j];
1731            }
1732            //tempPixels = null;
1733        } catch (Exception exc) {
1734            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "ReorderPixels",
1735                    new RendererException("Failed inside ReorderPixels", exc));
1736        }
1737    }
1738    /**
1739     * do not allow vertical segments for these, move the point x value by 1 pixel
1740     * @param tg tactical graphic
1741     */
1742    public static void FilterVerticalSegments(TGLight tg)
1743    {
1744        try
1745        {
1746            switch(tg.get_LineType())
1747            {
1748                case TacticalLines.AAFNT:
1749                case TacticalLines.MAIN:
1750                case TacticalLines.CATK:
1751                case TacticalLines.CATKBYFIRE:
1752                case TacticalLines.AXAD:
1753                case TacticalLines.AIRAOA:
1754                case TacticalLines.AAAAA:
1755                case TacticalLines.SPT:
1756                case TacticalLines.LC:
1757                case TacticalLines.LC2:
1758                case TacticalLines.UNSP:
1759                case TacticalLines.DFENCE:
1760                case TacticalLines.SFENCE:
1761                case TacticalLines.DOUBLEA:
1762                case TacticalLines.LWFENCE:
1763                case TacticalLines.HWFENCE:
1764                case TacticalLines.BBS_LINE:
1765                case TacticalLines.SINGLEC:
1766                case TacticalLines.SINGLEC2:
1767                case TacticalLines.DOUBLEC:
1768                case TacticalLines.DOUBLEC2:
1769                case TacticalLines.TRIPLE:
1770                case TacticalLines.TRIPLE2:
1771                case TacticalLines.BELT1:
1772                case TacticalLines.ALT:
1773                case TacticalLines.ONEWAY:
1774                case TacticalLines.TWOWAY:
1775                case TacticalLines.ATWALL:
1776                    break;
1777                default:
1778                    return;
1779            }
1780            POINT2 ptCurrent=null;
1781            POINT2 ptLast=null;
1782            int n=tg.Pixels.size();
1783            //for(int j=1;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
1784            for(int j=1;j<n;j++)
1785            {
1786                ptLast=new POINT2(tg.Pixels.get(j-1));
1787                ptCurrent=new POINT2(tg.Pixels.get(j));
1788                //if(Math.round(ptCurrent.x)==Math.round(ptLast.x))
1789                if(Math.abs(ptCurrent.x-ptLast.x)<1)
1790                {
1791                    if (ptCurrent.x>=ptLast.x)
1792                        ptCurrent.x += 1;
1793                    else
1794                        ptCurrent.x -= 1;
1795                    tg.Pixels.set(j, ptCurrent);
1796                }
1797            }
1798        }
1799        catch(Exception exc)
1800        {
1801            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsUtility", "FilterVerticalSegments",
1802                    new RendererException("Failed inside FilterVerticalSegments", exc));
1803
1804        }
1805    }
1806    /**
1807     * Client utility to calculate the channel points for channel types.
1808     * This code was ported from CJMTK.
1809     * @param arrLocation the client points
1810     * @return the channel point
1811     */
1812    public static POINT2 ComputeLastPoint(ArrayList<POINT2> arrLocation) {
1813        POINT2 locD = new POINT2(0, 0);
1814        try {
1815            POINT2 locA = arrLocation.get(1);
1816            //Get the first point (b) in pixels.
1817            //var locB:Point=new Point(arrLocation[0].x,arrLocation[0].y);
1818            POINT2 locB = arrLocation.get(0);
1819
1820            //Compute the distance in pixels from (a) to (b).
1821            double dblDx = locB.x - locA.x;
1822            double dblDy = locB.y - locA.y;
1823
1824            //Compute the dblAngle in radians from (a) to (b).
1825            double dblTheta = Math.atan2(-dblDy, dblDx);
1826
1827            //Compute a reasonable intermediate point along the line from (a) to (b).
1828            POINT2 locC = new POINT2(0, 0);
1829            locC.x = (int) (locA.x + 0.85 * dblDx);
1830            locC.y = (int) (locA.y + 0.85 * dblDy);
1831            //Put the last point on the left side of the line from (a) to (b).
1832            double dblAngle = dblTheta + Math.PI / 2.0;
1833            if (dblAngle > Math.PI) {
1834                dblAngle = dblAngle - 2.0 * Math.PI;
1835            }
1836            if (dblAngle < -Math.PI) {
1837                dblAngle = dblAngle + 2.0 * Math.PI;
1838            }
1839
1840            //Set the magnitude of the dblWidth in pixels.  Make sure it is at least 15 pixels.
1841            double dblWidth = 30;//was 15
1842
1843            //Compute the last point in pixels.
1844            locD.x = (locC.x + dblWidth * Math.cos(dblAngle));
1845            locD.y = (locC.y - dblWidth * Math.sin(dblAngle));
1846        } catch (Exception exc) {
1847            //clsUtility.WriteFile("Error in clsUtility.ComputeLatPoint");
1848            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "ComputeLastPoint",
1849                    new RendererException("Failed inside ComputeLastPoint", exc));
1850        }
1851        return locD;
1852    }

1854    /**
1855     * Called by clsChannelUtility. The segments are used for managing double-backed segments
1856     * for channel types. If the new point is double-backed then the segment at that index will be false.
1857     *
1858     * @param pixels the client points as 2-tuples x,y in pixels
1859     * @param segments OUT - the segments
1860     * @param factor a steepness factor for calculating whether the segment is double-backed
1861     */
1862    protected static void GetSegments(double[] pixels,
1863            boolean[] segments,
1864            double factor) {
1865        try
1866        {
1867            int j = 0;
1868            ref<double[]> m1 = new ref();
1869            ref<double[]> m2 = new ref();
1870            long numPoints = 0;
1871            boolean bolVertical1 = false;
1872            boolean bolVertical2 = false;
1873
1874            POINT2 pt0F = new POINT2(0, 0);
1875            POINT2 pt1F = new POINT2(0, 0);
1876            POINT2 pt2F = new POINT2(0, 0);
1877
1878            segments[0] = true;
1879            
1880            numPoints = pixels.length / 2;
1881            for (j = 0; j < numPoints - 2; j++)
1882            {
1883                pt0F.x = (double) pixels[2 * j];
1884                pt0F.y = (double) pixels[2 * j + 1];
1885
1886                pt1F.x = (double) pixels[2 * j + 2];
1887                pt1F.y = (double) pixels[2 * j + 3];
1888
1889                pt2F.x = (double) pixels[2 * j + 4];
1890                pt2F.y = (double) pixels[2 * j + 5];
1891
1892                bolVertical1 = lineutility.CalcTrueSlopeDoubleForRoutes(pt0F, pt1F, m1);
1893                bolVertical2 = lineutility.CalcTrueSlopeDoubleForRoutes(pt1F, pt2F, m2);
1894
1895                segments[j + 1] = true;
1896                if (bolVertical1 == true && bolVertical2 == true)
1897                {
1898                    if (Math.abs(Math.atan(m1.value[0]) - Math.atan(m2.value[0])) < 1 / factor && InXOrder(pt0F, pt1F, pt2F) == false) //was 0.1
1899                    {
1900                        segments[j + 1] = false;
1901                    }
1902                }
1903
1904                if ((bolVertical1 == false || Math.abs(m1.value[0]) > factor) && (bolVertical2 == false || Math.abs(m2.value[0]) > factor) && InYOrder(pt0F, pt1F, pt2F) == false) //was 10
1905                {
1906                    segments[j + 1] = false;
1907                }
1908            }   //end for
1909            //int n=segments.length;
1910        }
1911        catch (Exception exc)
1912        {
1913            //System.out.println(e.getMessage());
1914            //clsUtility.WriteFile("Error in clsUtility.GetSegments");
1915            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetSegments",
1916                    new RendererException("Failed inside GetSegments", exc));
1917        }
1918    }
1919
1920    protected static void GetLCPartitions(double[] pixels,
1921                                          double LCChannelWith,
1922                                          ArrayList<P1> partitions,
1923                                          ArrayList<P1> singleLinePartitions) {
1924        try
1925        {
1926            int numPoints = pixels.length / 2;
1927            POINT2 pt0F = new POINT2(0, 0);
1928            POINT2 pt1F = new POINT2(0, 0);
1929            POINT2 pt2F = new POINT2(0, 0);
1930
1931            P1 nextP = new P1();
1932            nextP.start = 0;
1933
1934            //used for debugging
1935            double[] angles = new double[numPoints - 1];
1936
1937            for (int i = 0; i < numPoints - 2; i++) {
1938                pt0F.x = (double) pixels[2 * i];
1939                pt0F.y = (double) pixels[2 * i + 1];
1940
1941                pt1F.x = (double) pixels[2 * i + 2];
1942                pt1F.y = (double) pixels[2 * i + 3];
1943
1944                pt2F.x = (double) pixels[2 * i + 4];
1945                pt2F.y = (double) pixels[2 * i + 5];
1946
1947                double angle1 = Math.atan2(pt1F.y - pt0F.y, pt1F.x - pt0F.x);
1948                double angle2 = Math.atan2(pt1F.y - pt2F.y, pt1F.x - pt2F.x);
1949                double angle = angle1-angle2;// * 180/Math.PI;
1950                double degrees = angle * 180/Math.PI;
1951                if (angle < 0) {
1952                    degrees = 360 + degrees;
1953                }
1954
1955                if (degrees > 270) {
1956                    boolean angleTooSmall = false;
1957
1958                    if (lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0F, pt1F) < lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt1F, pt2F)) {
1959                        POINT2 newPt = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pt1F, pt2F, lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt1F, pt0F));
1960                        if (lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0F, newPt) < LCChannelWith)
1961                            angleTooSmall = true;
1962                    } else {
1963                        POINT2 newPt = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pt1F, pt0F, lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt1F, pt2F));
1964                        if (lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt2F, newPt) < LCChannelWith)
1965                            angleTooSmall = true;
1966                    }
1967                    if (angleTooSmall) {
1968                        // Angle is too small to fit channel, make it a single line partition
1969                        nextP.end_Renamed = i - 1;
1970                        partitions.add(nextP);
1971                        nextP = new P1();
1972                        nextP.start = i;
1973                        nextP.end_Renamed=i + 2;
1974                        singleLinePartitions.add(nextP);
1975                        i++;
1976                        nextP = new P1();
1977                        nextP.start = i + 1;
1978                    }
1979                } else if(degrees < 90) {
1980                    // new Partition
1981                    nextP.end_Renamed = i;
1982                    partitions.add(nextP);
1983                    nextP = new P1();
1984                    nextP.start = i + 1;
1985                }
1986                angles[i] = degrees;
1987            } //end for
1988            nextP.end_Renamed = numPoints - 2;
1989            partitions.add(nextP);
1990        } catch (Exception exc) {
1991            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetLCPartitions",
1992                    new RendererException("Failed inside GetLCPartitions", exc));
1993        }
1994    }

2024    /**
2025     * USAS requires a left-right orientation for ENY, which negates the upper-lower
2026     * orientation we used for Mil-Std-2525 ENY compliance. Therefore we must reverse
2027     * the client points for two of the quadrants
2028     * @param tg tactical graphic
2029     */
2030    public static void ReverseUSASLCPointsByQuadrant(TGLight tg)
2031    {
2032        try
2033        {
2034            if(tg.Pixels.size()<2)
2035                return;
2036            int quadrant=lineutility.GetQuadrantDouble(tg.Pixels.get(0), tg.Pixels.get(1));
2037            switch(tg.get_LineType())
2038            {
2039                case TacticalLines.LC:
2040                case TacticalLines.LC2:
2041                    if(tg.get_Affiliation()!=null && tg.get_Affiliation().equals("H"))
2042                    {
2043                        switch(quadrant)
2044                        {
2045                            case 2:
2046                            case 3:
2047                                break;
2048                            case 1://reverse the points for these two quadrants
2049                            case 4:
2050                                int n=tg.Pixels.size();
2051                                ArrayList<POINT2> pts2=(ArrayList<POINT2>)tg.Pixels.clone();
2052                                        //for(int j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
2053                                        for(int j=0;j<n;j++)
2054                                            tg.Pixels.set(j, pts2.get(n-j-1));
2055                                break;
2056                        }//end switch quadrant
2057                    }//end if
2058                    else
2059                    {
2060                        switch(quadrant)
2061                        {
2062                            case 1:
2063                            case 4:
2064                                break;
2065                            case 2://reverse the points for these two quadrants
2066                            case 3:
2067                                int n=tg.Pixels.size();
2068                                ArrayList<POINT2> pts2=(ArrayList<POINT2>)tg.Pixels.clone();
2069                                        //for(int j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
2070                                        for(int j=0;j<n;j++)
2071                                            tg.Pixels.set(j, pts2.get(n-j-1));
2072                                break;
2073                        }//end switch quadrant
2074                    }//end else
2075                default:
2076                    break;
2077            }//end switch linetype
2078        }
2079        catch (Exception exc) {
2080            //WriteFile("Error in clsUtility.SetLCColor");
2081            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "ReverseUSASLCPointsByQuadrant",
2082                    new RendererException("Failed inside ReverseUSASLCPointsByQuadrant", exc));
2083        }
2084    }//end ReverseUSASLCPointsByQuadrant
2085    /**
2086     * 
2087     * @param tg tactical graphic
2088     * @param bi buffered image to use for creating a graphics object to draw
2089     * @return ShapeInfo hatch fill
2090     */
2091    public static Shape2 getHatchShape(TGLight tg,
2092            BufferedImage bi)
2093    {
2094        Shape2 shape=null;
2095        try
2096        {
2097            if(tg.get_UseHatchFill())
2098                return null;
2099            switch(tg.get_LineType())
2100            {
2101                case TacticalLines.OBSAREA:
2102                    break;
2103                default:
2104                    return null;
2105            }
2106            shape=new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
2107            shape.moveTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
2108            int j=0;
2109            int n=tg.Pixels.size();
2110            //for(j=1;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
2111            for(j=1;j<n;j++)
2112            {
2113                shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(j));
2114            }
2115            shape.setLineColor(new Color(0,0,0,0));
2116            shape.set_Fillstyle(3);
2117
2118            Rectangle2D.Double rect = null;
2119            Graphics2D grid = null;
2120            TexturePaint tp = tg.get_TexturePaint();
2121
2122            rect = new Rectangle2D.Double(0, 0, 8, 8);
2123            grid = bi.createGraphics();
2124            grid.setColor(clsUtility.GetOpaqueColor(tg.get_LineColor()));
2125
2126            grid.setStroke(new BasicStroke(2));
2127            grid.drawLine(0, 8, 8, 0);
2128            tp = new TexturePaint(bi, rect);
2129            shape.setTexturePaint(tp);
2130            shape.setFillColor(new Color(0,0,0,0));
2131            grid.dispose();
2132        }
2133        catch (Exception exc)
2134        {
2135            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"GetHatchShape",
2136                new RendererException("Failed inside GetHatchShape", exc));
2137        }
2138        return shape;
2139    }

2625    public static int GetLinetypeFromString(String str)

2627        int result=-1;

2629        {
2630            String strLine=str;
2631            String strMask=strLine.substring(0,1)+"*"+strLine.substring(2,3)+"P"+strLine.substring(4, 10)+"****X";            
2632            if(str.equalsIgnoreCase("GENERIC---****X"))
2633            {
2634                strMask=str;
2635            }
2636            else if(str.equalsIgnoreCase("BS_LINE--------"))
2637            {
2638                strMask=str;
2639            }
2640            else if(str.equalsIgnoreCase("BBS_LINE-------"))
2641            {
2642                strMask=str;
2643            }
2644            else if(str.equalsIgnoreCase("BS_AREA--------"))
2645            {
2646                strMask=str;
2647            }
2648            else if(str.equalsIgnoreCase("BBS_AREA-------"))
2649            {
2650                strMask=str;
2651            }
2652            else if(str.equalsIgnoreCase("BS_CROSS-------"))
2653            {
2654                strMask=str;
2655            }
2656            else if(str.equalsIgnoreCase("BBS_POINT------"))
2657            {
2658                strMask=str;
2659            }
2660            else if(str.equalsIgnoreCase("BS_ELLIPSE-----"))
2661            {
2662                strMask=str;
2663            }
2664            else if(str.equalsIgnoreCase("PBS_ELLIPSE----"))
2665            {
2666                strMask=str;
2667            }
2668            else if(str.equalsIgnoreCase("PBS_CIRCLE-----"))
2669            {
2670                strMask=str;
2671            }
2672            else if(str.equalsIgnoreCase("BS_RECTANGLE---"))
2673            {
2674                strMask=str;
2675            }
2676            else if(str.equalsIgnoreCase("PBS_RECTANGLE--"))
2677            {
2678                strMask=str;
2679            }
2680            else if(str.equalsIgnoreCase("PBS_SQUARE-----"))
2681            {
2682                strMask=str;
2683            }
2684            else if(str.equalsIgnoreCase("BBS_RECTANGLE--"))
2685            {
2686                strMask=str;
2687            }
2688            else if(str.equalsIgnoreCase("BS_BBOX--------"))
2689            {
2690                strMask=str;
2691            }
2692            
2693            Object objResult=null;
2694            if(linetypes != null && metocs != null)
2695            {
2696                objResult=linetypes.get(strMask);

2711    /**
2712     * Rev C requires max 50 anchor points for the axis of advance symbols
2713     * 
2714     * @param tg tactical graphic
2715     */
2716    public static void setRevC(TGLight tg)
2717    {
2718        try
2719        {
2720            //if(tg.getSymbologyStandard()!=RendererSettings.Symbology_2525C)
2721                //return;
2722            
2723            int rev=tg.getSymbologyStandard();
2724            if(rev==RendererSettings.Symbology_2525B)
2725            {
2726                switch(tg.get_LineType())
2727                {
2728                    case TacticalLines.MRR:
2729                        //if(tg.Pixels.size()>2)                        
2730                            tg.set_LineType(TacticalLines.MRR_USAS);                        
2731                        return;
2732                    case TacticalLines.UAV:
2733                        //if(tg.Pixels.size()>2)                        
2734                            tg.set_LineType(TacticalLines.UAV_USAS);                        
2735                        return;
2736                    default:
2737                        return;
2738                }
2739            }
2740            //should be rev C at this point
2741            if(rev==RendererSettings.Symbology_2525C)
2742            {
2743                switch(tg.get_LineType())
2744                {
2745                    case TacticalLines.SCREEN:
2746                        if(tg.Pixels.size()==4)
2747                            tg.set_LineType(TacticalLines.SCREEN_REVC);
2748                        break;
2749                    case TacticalLines.GUARD:
2750                        if(tg.Pixels.size()==4)
2751                            tg.set_LineType(TacticalLines.GUARD_REVC);
2752                        break;
2753                    case TacticalLines.COVER:
2754                        if(tg.Pixels.size()==4)
2755                            tg.set_LineType(TacticalLines.COVER_REVC);
2756                        break;
2757                    case TacticalLines.SEIZE:                    
2758                        if(tg.Pixels.size()==4)
2759                            tg.set_LineType(TacticalLines.SEIZE_REVC);
2760                        break;
2761                    case TacticalLines.PAA_RECTANGULAR:                    
2762                        tg.set_LineType(TacticalLines.PAA_RECTANGULAR_REVC);
2763                        break;
2764                    default:
2765                        break;
2766                }
2767            }
2768            switch(tg.get_LineType())
2769            {
2770                case TacticalLines.SCREEN_REVC:
2771                    if(tg.Pixels.size()<4)
2772                        tg.set_LineType(TacticalLines.SCREEN);
2773                    break;
2774                case TacticalLines.GUARD_REVC:
2775                    if(tg.Pixels.size()<4)
2776                        tg.set_LineType(TacticalLines.GUARD);
2777                    break;
2778                case TacticalLines.COVER_REVC:
2779                    if(tg.Pixels.size()<4)
2780                        tg.set_LineType(TacticalLines.COVER);
2781                    break;
2782                case TacticalLines.SEIZE_REVC:                    
2783                    if(tg.Pixels.size()<4)
2784                        tg.set_LineType(TacticalLines.SEIZE);
2785                    break;
2786                default:
2787                    break;
2788            }//end switch            
2789        }//end try
2790        catch (Exception exc) 
2791        {
2792            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"setRevC",
2793                    new RendererException("Failed inside setRevC", exc));
2794        }
2795    }

2904    /**
2905     * Client will send the segment colors within a modifier.
2906     * Format is 0:FFBBBB,4:FFAAAA,...
2907     * For the time being will assume the modifier being used is the H modifier
2908     * @param tg
2909     * @return 
2910     */
2911    public static HashMap<Integer,Color> getMSRSegmentColors(TGLight tg)
2912    {
2913        HashMap hMap=null;
2914        try
2915        {
2916            int linetype=tg.get_LineType();
2917            switch(linetype)
2918            {
2919                case TacticalLines.MSR:
2920                case TacticalLines.ASR:
2921                case TacticalLines.BOUNDARY:
2922                    if(tg.get_H()==null || tg.get_H().isEmpty())
2923                        return null;
2924                    hMap=new HashMap<Integer,Color>();
2925                    break;
2926                default:
2927                    return null;
2928            }
2929            String[]colorStrs=tg.get_H().split(",");
2930            int j=0,numSegs=colorStrs.length;
2931            String segPlusColor="";
2932            String[]seg=null;     
2933            Color color=null;
2934            int index=-1;
2935            for(j=0;j<numSegs;j++)
2936            {
2937                segPlusColor=colorStrs[j];
2938                if(!segPlusColor.contains(":"))
2939                    continue;
2940                seg=segPlusColor.split(":");
2941                color=SymbolUtilities.getColorFromHexString(seg[1]);
2942                index=Integer.parseInt(seg[0]);
2943                hMap.put(index, color);
2944            }
2945        }
2946        catch (Exception exc)
2947        {
2948            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"getMSRSegmentColors",
2949                    new RendererException("Failed inside getMSRSegmentColors", exc));
2950        }
2951        return hMap;
2952    }

2995    /**
2996     * tg.H must be revised for clipped MSR, ASR and Boundary
2997     * This function is called after the pixels were clipped
2998     * @param originalPixels the tactical graphic pixels before clipping
2999     * @param tg 
3000     */
3001    public static void reviseHModifier(ArrayList<POINT2>originalPixels, 
3002            TGLight tg)
3003    {
3004        try
3005        {
3006            //only revise tg.H if it is not null or empty
3007            //and the linetype is bounday, MSR, or ASR
3008            if(tg.get_H()==null || tg.get_H().isEmpty())
3009                return;
3010            int linetype=tg.get_LineType();
3011            switch(linetype)
3012            {
3013                case TacticalLines.ASR:
3014                case TacticalLines.MSR:
3015                case TacticalLines.BOUNDARY:
3016                    break;
3017                default:
3018                    return;
3019            }
3020            int j=0,k=0;
3021            //Line2D line=new Line2D.Double();
3022            
3023            //get the first common point between the original points and tg.Pixels
3024            //if it is n then n segments will have been dropped at the front end of
3025            //the clipped array (from the original pixels) so then we would want to
3026            //set the start index to n for the loop through the original points
3027            int n=-1; 
3028            boolean foundPt=false;
3029            int t=originalPixels.size();
3030            int u=tg.Pixels.size();
3031            //for(j=0;j<originalPixels.size();j++)
3032            for(j=0;j<t;j++)
3033            {
3034                //for(k=0;k<tg.Pixels.size();k++)
3035                for(k=0;k<u;k++)
3036                {
3037                    if(originalPixels.get(j).x==tg.Pixels.get(k).x && originalPixels.get(j).y==tg.Pixels.get(k).y)
3038                    {
3039                        n=j;
3040                        foundPt=true;
3041                        break;
3042                    }
3043                }
3044                if(foundPt)
3045                    break;
3046            }
3047            HashMap<Integer,Color> hmap=getMSRSegmentColors(tg);
3048            //use a 2nd hashmap to store the revised segment numbers, and exisitng Colors
3049            HashMap<Integer,Color> hmap2=new HashMap<Integer,Color>();
3050            POINT2 segPt0=null,segPt1=null; //the original segments
3051            POINT2 pt0=null,pt1=null;   //the clipped segments
3052            Color color=null;
3053            if(n<1)
3054                n=1;
3055            for(Integer key : hmap.keySet()) //keys can begin at 0
3056            {
3057                if(key<n-1)
3058                    continue;
3059                if(key+1>originalPixels.size()-1)
3060                    break;
3061                color=hmap.get(key);
3062                segPt0=originalPixels.get(key);
3063                segPt1=originalPixels.get(key+1);
3064                u=tg.Pixels.size();
3065                //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size()-1;j++)
3066                for(j=0;j<u-1;j++)
3067                {
3068                    pt0=tg.Pixels.get(j);//clipped pixels
3069                    pt1=tg.Pixels.get(j+1);
3070                    if(segPt0.x==pt0.x && segPt0.y==pt0.y)
3071                    {
3072                        hmap2.put(j, color);
3073                        break;
3074                    }
3075                    else if(segPt1.x==pt1.x && segPt1.y==pt1.y)
3076                    {
3077                        hmap2.put(j, color);
3078                        break;
3079                    }
3080                    else
3081                    {
3082                        if(pt0.x==segPt1.x && pt0.y==segPt1.y)
3083                            continue;
3084                        if(pt1.x==segPt0.x && pt1.y==segPt0.y)
3085                            continue;
3086                        else    
3087                        {       
3088                            //if the original segment straddles or clips the clipping area
3089                            //then the original segment will contain the clipped segment
3090                            double dist0=lineutility.CalcDistanceToLineDouble(segPt0, segPt1, pt0);
3091                            double dist1=lineutility.CalcDistanceToLineDouble(segPt0, segPt1, pt1);
3092                            Line2D lineOrigPts=new Line2D.Double(segPt0.x,segPt0.y, segPt1.x,segPt1.y);
3093                            Rectangle2D rectOrigPts=lineOrigPts.getBounds2D();
3094                            Line2D lineClipPts=new Line2D.Double(pt0.x,pt0.y, pt1.x, pt1.y);
3095                            Rectangle2D rectClipPts=lineClipPts.getBounds2D();
3096                            //test if the lines coincide and the clipped segment is within the original segment
3097                            if(dist0<1 && dist1<1 && rectOrigPts.contains(rectClipPts))
3098                            {
3099                                hmap2.put(j, color);                                
3100                            }
3101                        }
3102                    }
3103                }
3104            }        
3105            if(hmap2.isEmpty())
3106            {
3107                tg.set_H(null);
3108                return;
3109            }
3110           
3111            String h="",temp="";
3112            for(Integer key : hmap2.keySet()) 
3113            {
3114                color=hmap2.get(key);
3115                temp=Integer.toHexString(color.toARGB());
3116                h+=key.toString()+":"+temp+",";
3117            }
3118            h=h.substring(0, h.length()-1);
3119            tg.set_H(h);
3120        }
3121        catch (Exception exc) {
3122            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "reviseHModifer",
3123                    new RendererException("Failed inside reviseHModifier", exc));
3124        }
3125    }
