3127    /**
3128     * Adds extra points to LC if there are angles too small to fit the channel
3129     * @param tg
3130     * @param converter
3131     */
3132    public static void SegmentLCPoints(TGLight tg, IPointConversion converter) {
3133        try {
3134            if (tg.get_LineType() != TacticalLines.LC && tg.get_LineType() != TacticalLines.LC_HOSTILE)
3135                return;
3136
3137            ArrayList<POINT2> points = tg.get_Pixels();
3138
3139            double LCChannelWith = 40;
3140
3141            for (int i = 0; i < points.size() - 2; i++) {
3142                POINT2 ptA = new POINT2(points.get(i).x, points.get(i).y);
3143                POINT2 ptB = new POINT2(points.get(i+1).x, points.get(i+1).y);
3144                POINT2 ptC = new POINT2(points.get(i+2).x, points.get(i+2).y);
3145
3146                double angle1 = Math.atan2(ptB.y - ptA.y, ptB.x - ptA.x);
3147                double angle2 = Math.atan2(ptB.y - ptC.y, ptB.x - ptC.x);
3148                double angle = angle1 - angle2;
3149                double degrees = angle * 180/Math.PI;
3150
3151                if(angle < 0) {
3152                    degrees = 360 + degrees;
3153                }
3154
3155                if (degrees > 270) {
3156                    // For acute angles where red is the outer line
3157                    // Determine shorter segment (BA or BC)
3158                    // On longer segment calculate potential new point (newPt) that is length of smaller segment from B
3159                    // If distance between smaller segment end point (A or C) and newPt is smaller than the channel width add newPt to points
3160                    // In GetLCPartitions() the black line won't be included between the smaller line and newPt since there isn't enough space to fit the channel
3161                    if (lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(ptB, ptA) < lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(ptB, ptC)) {
3162                        // BA is smaller segment
3163                        POINT2 newPt = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(ptB, ptC, lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(ptB, ptA));
3164                        if (lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(ptA, newPt) < LCChannelWith) {
3165                            points.add(i + 2, new POINT2(newPt.x, newPt.y));
3166                            i++;
3167                        }
3168                    } else {
3169                        // BC is smaller segment
3170                        POINT2 newPt = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(ptB, ptA, lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(ptB, ptC));
3171                        if (lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(ptC, newPt) < LCChannelWith) {
3172                            points.add(i + 1, new POINT2(newPt.x, newPt.y));
3173                            i++;
3174                        }
3175                    }
3176                }
3177            }
3178            tg.Pixels = points;
3179            tg.LatLongs = armyc2.c2sd.JavaRendererServer.RenderMultipoints.clsUtility.PixelsToLatLong(points, converter);
3180        } catch (Exception exc) {
3181            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "segmentLCPoints",
3182                    new RendererException("Failed inside segmentLCPoints", exc));
3183        }
3184    }
3185    /**
3186     * Interpolate pixels for lines with points too close together.
3187     * Drops successive points until the next point is at least 10 pixels from the preceding point
3188     * @param tg 
3189     */
3190    public static void InterpolatePixels(TGLight tg)
3191    {
3192        try
3193        {
3194            if(tg.get_UseLineInterpolation()==false)
3195                return;
3196            
3197            int linetype=tg.get_LineType();
3198            double glyphSize=10;
3199            switch(linetype)
3200            {
3201                case TacticalLines.ATDITCH:
3202                case TacticalLines.ATDITCHC:
3203                    glyphSize=25;
3204                    break;
3205                case TacticalLines.ATDITCHM:
3206                    glyphSize=50;
3207                    break;
3208                case TacticalLines.DMAF:
3209                    glyphSize=20;
3210                    break;
3211                case TacticalLines.FLOT:
3212                case TacticalLines.LC:
3213                case TacticalLines.FORT:
3214                case TacticalLines.FORTL:
3215                case TacticalLines.ENCIRCLE:
3216                case TacticalLines.BELT:
3217                case TacticalLines.ZONE:
3218                case TacticalLines.OBSFAREA:
3219                case TacticalLines.OBSAREA:
3220                case TacticalLines.DOUBLEA:
3221                case TacticalLines.LWFENCE:
3222                case TacticalLines.HWFENCE:
3223                case TacticalLines.BBS_LINE:
3224                case TacticalLines.SINGLEC:
3225                case TacticalLines.DOUBLEC:
3226                case TacticalLines.TRIPLE:
3227                case TacticalLines.STRONG:
3228                    glyphSize=30;
3229                    break;
3230                case TacticalLines.UNSP:
3231                case TacticalLines.LINE:
3232                case TacticalLines.ATWALL:
3233                case TacticalLines.SFENCE:
3234                    glyphSize=40;
3235                    break;
3236                case TacticalLines.DFENCE:
3237                    glyphSize=50;
3238                    break;
3239                default:
3240                    return;
3241            }
3242            HashMap hmapPixels=new HashMap<Integer,POINT2>();
3243            HashMap hmapGeo=new HashMap<Integer,POINT2>();
3244            int j=0,currentIndex=0;
3245            double dist=0,dist2=0;
3246            double direction1=0,direction2=0,delta=0;
3247            POINT2 pt0=null,pt1=null,pt2=null;
3248            int n=tg.Pixels.size();
3249            //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
3250            for(j=0;j<n;j++)
3251            {
3252                if(j==0)
3253                {
3254                    hmapPixels.put(j, tg.Pixels.get(j));
3255                    hmapGeo.put(j, tg.LatLongs.get(j));
3256                    currentIndex=0;
3257                }
3258                else if(j==tg.Pixels.size()-1)
3259                {
3260                    hmapPixels.put(j, tg.Pixels.get(j));
3261                    hmapGeo.put(j, tg.LatLongs.get(j));                    
3262                }
3263                else
3264                {
3265                    dist=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(tg.Pixels.get(currentIndex), tg.Pixels.get(j));
3266                    dist2=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(tg.Pixels.get(j), tg.Pixels.get(j+1));
3267                    
3268                    //change of direction test 2-28-13
3269                    pt0=tg.Pixels.get(currentIndex);
3270                    pt1=tg.Pixels.get(j);
3271                    pt2=tg.Pixels.get(j+1);
3272                    direction1=(180/Math.PI)*Math.atan((pt0.y-pt1.y)/(pt0.x-pt1.x));
3273                    direction2=(180/Math.PI)*Math.atan((pt1.y-pt2.y)/(pt1.x-pt2.x));
3274                    delta=Math.abs(direction1-direction2);
3275                    if(dist>glyphSize || dist2>glyphSize || delta>20)
3276                    {
3277                        hmapPixels.put(j, tg.Pixels.get(j));
3278                        hmapGeo.put(j, tg.LatLongs.get(j));
3279                        currentIndex=j;
3280                    }
3281                }
3282            }
3283            ArrayList<POINT2>pixels=new ArrayList();
3284            ArrayList<POINT2>geo=new ArrayList();
3285            n=tg.Pixels.size();
3286            //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
3287            for(j=0;j<n;j++)
3288            {
3289                if(hmapPixels.containsKey(j))
3290                    pixels.add((POINT2)hmapPixels.get(j));
3291                if(hmapGeo.containsKey(j))
3292                    geo.add((POINT2)hmapGeo.get(j));
3293            }
3294            switch(linetype)
3295            {
3296                case TacticalLines.DMAF:
3297                case TacticalLines.FORT:
3298                case TacticalLines.ENCIRCLE:
3299                case TacticalLines.BELT:
3300                case TacticalLines.ZONE:
3301                case TacticalLines.OBSFAREA:
3302                case TacticalLines.OBSAREA:
3303                case TacticalLines.STRONG:
3304                    if(pixels.size()==2)
3305                    {
3306                        n=tg.Pixels.size();
3307                        //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
3308                        for(j=0;j<n;j++)
3309                        {
3310                            if(hmapPixels.containsKey(j)==false && hmapGeo.containsKey(j)==false)
3311                            {
3312                                pixels.add(j,tg.Pixels.get(j));
3313                                geo.add(j,tg.LatLongs.get(j));
3314                                break;
3315                            }
3316                        }                        
3317                    }
3318                    break;
3319                default:
3320                    break;
3321            }            
3322            tg.Pixels=pixels;
3323            tg.LatLongs=geo;
3324        }
3325        catch (Exception exc) {
3326            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "InterpolatePixels",
3327                    new RendererException("Failed inside InterpolatePixels", exc));
3328        }
3329    }
3330    /**
3331     * construct a line segment outside the polygon corresponding to some index
3332     * @param tg
3333     * @param index
3334     * @param dist
3335     * @return 
3336     */
3337    protected static Line2D getExtendedLine(TGLight tg,
3338            int index,
3339            double dist)
3340    {
3341        Line2D line=null;
3342        try
3343        {
3344            Polygon polygon=new Polygon();
3345            int j=0;
3346            int n=tg.Pixels.size();
3347            //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
3348            for(j=0;j<n;j++)
3349            {
3350                polygon.addPoint((int)tg.Pixels.get(j).x, (int)tg.Pixels.get(j).y);
3351            }
3352            POINT2 pt0=null; 
3353            POINT2 pt1=null; 
3354            if(tg.Pixels.size()>3)
3355            {
3356                pt0=tg.Pixels.get(index);
3357                pt1=tg.Pixels.get(index+1);
3358            }
3359            else
3360            {
3361                pt0=tg.Pixels.get(1);
3362                pt1=tg.Pixels.get(2);                
3363            }
3364            
3365            POINT2 ptExtend=null;
3366            int extend=-1;
3367            POINT2 midPt=lineutility.MidPointDouble(pt0, pt1,0);
3368            double slope=Math.abs(pt1.y-pt0.y)/(pt1.x-pt0.x);
3369            if(slope<=1)
3370            {
3371                ptExtend=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, pt1, midPt, lineutility.extend_above, 2);
3372                if(polygon.contains(ptExtend.x,ptExtend.y))
3373                    extend=lineutility.extend_below;
3374                else
3375                    extend=lineutility.extend_above;
3376            }
3377            else
3378            {
3379                ptExtend=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, pt1, midPt, lineutility.extend_left, 2);
3380                if(polygon.contains(ptExtend.x,ptExtend.y))
3381                    extend=lineutility.extend_right;
3382                else
3383                    extend=lineutility.extend_left;
3384                
3385            }
3386            POINT2 pt3=null;
3387            POINT2 pt4=null;
3388            pt3=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, pt1, pt0, extend, dist);
3389            pt4=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, pt1, pt1, extend, dist);
3390            line=new Line2D.Double(pt3.x, pt3.y, pt4.x, pt4.y);
3391        }
3392        catch (Exception exc) {            
3393            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "getExtendedLine",
3394                    new RendererException("Failed inside getExtendedLine", exc));
3395        }
3396        return line;
3397    }
